<title level="1" pfs="">[Troodon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3260)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Troodons stand roughly 3 feet tall and twice as long, with slender necks and large, inquisitive eyes. Although they don't fully understand language, troodons have a remarkable talent for speech mimicry.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Troodon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3260)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Dinosaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=576" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 136

**Perception** +9; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +6, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +5, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) +8, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +8, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +3

**Con** +1

**Int** -4

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +3
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +4 

**Ref** +8 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +8 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d8+1 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +8 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+1 slashing

**Mimicry** <actions string="Single Action" />  The troodon repeats up to twelve words it heard in the last week. If it succeeds at a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) check against the listeners' Perception DC, the sound is indistinguishable from the original. The troodon can't duplicate voice-based abilities or spells, although it can mimic the verbal sounds of spellcasting.

**Running Attack** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The troodon Strides and makes a claw Strike at any point during that movement.

</column>
